name: Minimum linear arrangement on gd96a
definition: For the fixed undirected unweighted graph gd96a, assign each vertex a distinct position from 1 through 1,096 and minimize the sum of edge lengths.
solution_format: An object with ordering, a list containing each vertex ID 1 through 1,096 exactly once.
constraints: Each entry is an integer vertex ID from 1 through 1,096.
Every vertex ID occurs exactly once.
The objective is the sum of absolute position differences over all 1,676 undirected edges in gd96a.
verification: Exact permutation checks and an exact integer sum over the pinned 1,676-edge graph; verification takes less than one second locally.

source_review.definition: 官方无权无向gd96a图，1096顶点1676边，对顶点作双射排列，最小化全部边跨度和；不是最小化最大跨度或最大化最小跨度。
